issues.explanation: Ticket factory computes code from a throwaway queue so every ticket gets A001 and forQueue duplicates violate the unique constraint.
Both models declare casts via attribute but casts() returns empty so enum, datetime, boolean and array casts never apply.
Queue model has the same empty casts() so is_active boolean and labels_i18n array casts never apply.
nextCode orders by numeric value of code instead of insertion order and does not strictly filter to A<digits>, mishandling cases like A123X.
IssueTicket relies on transaction attempts which only retry deadlocks, so a unique queue_id/code collision is not explicitly retried.
The diff contains no Pest/PHPUnit test files despite the conventions requiring tests for every feature.
Write-once save() allows only status, called_at and called_by_user_id but omits the permitted updated_at.
Docs updates add only generic one-liners and do not document display codes, issuance, write-once or single-call rules.
Ticket model imports DateTime facade and ValidationException without use and QueueFactory duplicates the Entity import.

conventions.evidence: No test files despite TDD requirement; docs/business-rules.md:1-8 and docs/database-schema.md trivial one-liners; #[Castable] with empty casts() does not match casts contract

readability.evidence: app/Models/Ticket.php:215-250 nextCode/call/save are small and clear; empty casts() is misleading; orderByRaw CAST(SUBSTRING) is MySQL-specific; unused imports

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Ticket.php:196-199 casts() returns []; database/factories/TicketFactory.php:328 code from throwaway queue breaks forQueue A001/A002; app/Models/Ticket.php:216-220 orders by CAST numeric not insertion order; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:29-44 no unique-collision retry

scope.evidence: All touched files serve the task (Actions, Enums, Models, factories, migrations, docs); no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: app/Models/Ticket.php:241-244 membership check throws AuthorizationException before mutation; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:31-34 lockForUpdate plus DB re-check; priority validated; no Livewire/UI surface

simplicity.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:18-47 lean action reusing Ticket::nextCode; no service layers; minor dead code in duplicate use Entity and unused imports

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files; no happy-path, edge-case, unauthorized-call or tamper tests

review.summary: The change implements the happy-path queues/tickets domain with correct locking, auth checks and migrations, but breaks contract details: casts are empty, nextCode uses numeric order, the ticket factory always allocates A001, unique-collision retry is missing, docs are superficial, and no tests ship, requiring substantial rework.
